frequency_question: How often do these principals exercise their will to activate a non-zero countercyclical buffer when operating under a mandate that permits it?
membership_rule: Members are central banking regulatory boards possessing the explicit statutory power to adjust the countercyclical capital buffer (such as the Federal Reserve, Bank of England, or Reserve Bank of Australia) evaluated during periods of macroprudential policy review. Excluded are entities lacking independent regulatory authority over capital buffers.

cases.name: Bank of England FPC activation of UK CCyB
Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB activation
